title: Vintage Charm-Wine cellar with Barroom, sleeps 12!
description:
Gorgeous renovation! Two queen bedrooms on top floor with master bathroom/jacuzzi tub.  Bath is also accessible from the hallway for second queen bedroom.  Main floor: kitchen, living room, deck, bath, and two bedrooms -two bunk beds sleeping 4 and the other bedroom with two twin beds. Bottom floor bar room/wine cellar has a full sleeper sofa, plus private retreat area with king bed and laundry closet.  Third bathroom off private retreat, with second door to garage/bar room.

The space
This house was my first home, and is truly one of my favorite places.  The extensive renovations this past year have completely transformed it!  It's the perfect place to enjoy your time together in a charming and peaceful setting, until you're ready to go out again into the Nashville excitement.  I truly hope it becomes a home away from home for you, and you return often to enjoy time with friends and family.

Guest access
Entire house - keypad entry with code provided the day before arrival.
